runtimeSettings.title: Runtime Settings
runtimeSettings.description: Configure the global concurrency value used by session queue scheduling.
runtimeSettings.loadErrorDescription: Try again before editing this setting.

maxConcurrentSessions.label: Max concurrent sessions
maxConcurrentSessions.helper: Leave blank for unlimited sessions. Set 1 for local LLM setups that can only run one session at a time.
maxConcurrentSessions.invalid: Enter a whole number greater than 0, or leave blank for none.

harnessesPanel.defaultModelDescription: Used when new sessions start without an explicit Harness or model. Its run options below apply to every session of this Harness.

betaFeatures.title: Beta features
betaFeatures.description: Try beta features. This setting applies to every project and dashboard connected to this installation.

settings.title: Performance monitoring
settings.description: Measure frame rate, CPU, and slow frames in this app. Nothing is measured while this is off. Measurements stay on this device and are never uploaded.
settings.helperOff: Saved on this device only. Other devices and remote runtimes keep their own setting.
settings.helperDesktopOn: On for this device. Shows frame rate in the status bar. Samples every 2 seconds and keeps the last 30 seconds.
settings.helperBrowserOn: On for this browser. Shows frame rate in the status bar and records slow frames while this tab is open.

popover.title: Performance
popover.statusLabel: Frame rate {{fps}} fps. Show performance details.
popover.cpuUnavailableBody: Frame rate still updates. Pause still works.
popover.browserTitle: CPU is measured in the desktop app
popover.browserBody: A browser tab cannot read CPU. Pause still works.
popover.sustainedBody: {{process}} averaged {{cpu}} CPU over the last {{seconds}} seconds.

paused.title: {{name}} is paused
paused.body: Paused from the performance monitor. Its views stay unloaded until you resume.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how Prompt Studio looks. You can also change the theme with Alt+Shift+T.

connectionStatus.title: Connection status
connectionStatus.description: Show the backend connection status in the status bar.
connectionStatus.saveError: Could not change connection status display.
